pageSummary: AIReadyWebsite.tsx is a thick custom-design page with extensive deviations from /framework: it defines its own token constants (CRIMSON/CHARCOAL/CREAM etc), uses inline style colors/Fonts instead of Tailwind utilities, omits font-serif on heading classes, uses rounded-none buttons/cards, applies md:px-10 gutter, and uses 72px section spacing instead of 112px/144px. Essentially every category flagged is present at scale.
